concept.name: Stack'd
concept.tagline: Stacked burgers in Central Oakland, Pittsburgh

menu.name: Classic Cheeseburger
menu.description: Beef patty, American cheese, lettuce, tomato, onion, and pickles on a toasted bun.
menu.imagePrompt: A stacked cheeseburger with melted American cheese in a white paper takeout wrapper on a kraft paper tray, soft natural light, shallow depth of field.

menu.name: Bacon Cheeseburger
menu.description: Beef patty with crispy bacon and American cheese on a toasted bun.
menu.imagePrompt: A bacon cheeseburger with crisp bacon strips peeking out, in a paper takeout box, on a wooden table, warm lighting.

menu.name: Double Stack Burger
menu.description: Two beef patties stacked with cheese, lettuce, tomato, and house sauce.
menu.imagePrompt: A tall double-patty burger with two melted cheese slices in a paper sleeve, takeout bag beside it, overhead view.

menu.name: Chicken Sandwich
menu.description: Crispy fried chicken breast with lettuce, tomato, and mayo on a brioche bun.
menu.imagePrompt: A crispy fried chicken sandwich in a paper takeout wrapper with a side of fries in a cardboard tray.

menu.name: Veggie Burger
menu.description: Plant-based patty with lettuce, tomato, onion, and pickles on a toasted bun.
menu.imagePrompt: A plant-based veggie burger with fresh lettuce and tomato in a paper wrapper, bright natural light.

menu.name: Chicken Fingers Combo
menu.description: Crispy chicken fingers with fries and your choice of dipping sauce.
menu.imagePrompt: Golden chicken fingers and fries in a cardboard takeout tray with dipping sauce cups, overhead view.

menu.name: Crinkle Fries
menu.imagePrompt: A paper cup of crinkle-cut fries with salt flakes, on a takeout tray.

menu.name: Fountain Drink
menu.imagePrompt: A large paper cup with lid and straw, condensation on the outside, on a takeout counter.

brand.logoPrompt: A flat two-color mark: the word Stack'd with a small burger stack icon above the apostrophe, bold rounded sans-serif.
brand.voice: Casual and friendly, speaking to students and neighbors like a regular spot down the block.
